versions.changelog: Vault-agnostic ghcli setup: removed KeePassXC token requirement, added inline Google OAuth client JSON support, and declared GHCLI_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_JSON for OpenClaw SecretRef injection.

Update public positioning to Google Health (Fitbit) Local Archive, clarify Google Health API access for Fitbit/Google health accounts, and avoid wording that implies a separate Fitbit-to-Google-Health data movement path.
Fresh-install fixes: tagged go install now reports v1.0.3, empty query responses return [], and first-run migrations serialize concurrent diagnostics and queries.
Restore ghcli as an explicit required binary, add Go install metadata, and document the local-first setup/query boundary.
